listing.name: Adjustable S-Mods 1.1.2
listing.summary: A mod for Starsector that allows the player to remove s-mods or to increase the max s-mod limit of a ship.
listing.aiSummary: Lets you remove s-mods from ships or increase their maximum s-mod count.

description: Allows players to manually remove installed s-mods from their ships. It also lets you raise the maximum number of s-mod slots available on a ship.
descriptionHtml: Allows players to manually remove installed s-mods from their ships. It also lets you raise the maximum number of s-mod slots available on a ship.
discordPostHtml:
A mod for Starsector that allows the player to remove s-mods or to increase the max s-mod limit of a ship.

Requirements:

  • Lunalib

Compatibility:

  • Should be compatible with most mods
  • Not safe to remove from an ongoing campaign
  • Not save compatible with versions below 1.0.0

For mod changes check out the changelog link.

Download: https://github.com/AudaxLudos/adjustable-s-mods/releases/download/1.1.2/AdjustableSMods-1.1.2.zip
Changelog: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AudaxLudos/adjustable-s-mods/main/CHANGELOG.txt
Old Versions: https://github.com/AudaxLudos/adjustable-s-mods/releases
